newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed expects to save NOK 600 per year.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed expects to save NOK 600 per year.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA said on Wednesday it expected to make savings of 600 million crowns per year before tax from 1998.
In a statement annoucing full-year 1996 results, the company said the savings would come from its Focus 98 cost-cutting programme, which it implemented in the fourth quarter.
"Through this plan the company expects to save at least 600 million crowns before tax, with full effect from 1998," it said.
Nycomed said pre-tax profits for full-year 1996 were 365 million crowns after restructuring expenses compared with 1.69 billion crowns in the corresponding year ago period.
